ye10427bc4f5.add: - **Earthquake indoors:** take cover **under a strong table** (Drop, Cover, Hold); keep away from **windows, balconies and staircases**.

y68d8ee30c40.add: - **2nd BIMSTEC DMEx-2020** (11-13 Feb 2020, NDRF nodal): inaugurated at **Bhubaneswar**, field exercise at Puri (Odisha); the 1st (2017) was in New Delhi-NCR.

y89ef5d8da1c.add: - **Lightning:** **do not stand under trees** or in open fields; go indoors or crouch low; alerts via the **Damini** (IMD) and AP **Vajrapath** apps.

ybed0ddc9736.add: - **Vajrapath** (July 2017): APSDMA **lightning** alert app built with **ISRO**, warns about **45 minutes** ahead.

y1ff78422943.add: - **Incident Command System (ICS)**: a standard management system for incidents of **all kinds and sizes**; India uses it as the **Incident Response System (IRS)** (NDMA guidelines 2010).

yd1b8426c13c.add: - **DEM = Digital Elevation Model**: digital terrain/elevation surface used in GIS for flood, inundation and landslide modelling.

y48523c26742.add: - Phase definitions (FEMA): **mitigation** – minimising the effects of disaster; **preparedness** – planning how to respond; **response** – efforts to minimise the hazards created by a disaster; **recovery** – returning the community to normal.
